title: Net worth: the one number that sums up your money

lines.text: There's one number that sums up your whole financial life. Dot, what is it?

scene.headline: The [one number] that sums up your money

lines.text: It's your net worth. Everything you own, minus everything you owe.

scene.def: What you [own], minus what you owe.

lines.text: Say you have eight thousand dollars in savings and a car worth twelve thousand.

scene.def: What you [own], minus what you owe.

lines.text: That's twenty thousand in assets. Now subtract fifteen thousand in student loans and three thousand on a card.

scene.title: Example: what you own vs what you owe

lines.text: Your net worth is two thousand dollars.
And if it's negative right now? That's common early on. What matters is that it climbs over time.

scene.headline: Negative? [Normal] early on.
scene.sub: Watch the trend, not the snapshot

lines.text: That's the money. See you at the next bell.
